thread:
ajay.k: Heads-up — customer 'acme-payments' seeing a sudden spike of 429s on Dedicated this evening. They report increased latency then throttles. I grabbed a few control-plane router logs and it looks like requests with X-Tenant header containing trailing whitespace are falling through our pool selector regex and landing in the default coldpool (=> unintended throttling).

support_lead: Oof. Can you paste a sample request id + header value so we can repro? Also what time window and region?

ajay.k: Sample request_id: req_20260317_1147_9a3b. Region: us-west-2. Header observed: `X-Tenant: acme-payments ` (note trailing space). Router log snippet:```
2026-03-17T11:47:03.212Z router[controlplane-01] INFO pool_select: tenant_header=\"acme-payments \" selector=regex:\"^acme-.*:gold\" match=NO -> default_pool=coldpool-std-1
2026-03-17T11:47:03.213Z router[controlplane-01] WARN route_throttle: pool=coldpool-std-1 throttle_rate=0.8 latency_ms=420
```

devon: That regex was intentionally strict (anchors + no trimming) to avoid accidental tenant collisions. Looks like we never normalize whitespace in the control plane selector path. If the gateway sends trailing spaces or if header concat introduces an extra comma, match fails.

ingress-bot: Observed at LB: `X-Tenant: acme-payments,` for ~1200 reqs during 11:46-11:50. Some backends returned 400 due to header parsing in sidecar.

maria_p: Two asks: 1) short-term mitigation (so customer isn't throttled), 2) long-term fix (selector tolerant / header normalization). For mitigation we can add a header-normalize filter at the gateway or a routing override rule for acme-payments to map -> gold-dedicated-pool.

eng-runtime-oncall: Escalating to eng-routing. For immediate workaround we can push a temporary match override on control-plane: `tenant=='acme-payments' -> pool=gold-dedicated-usw2` (manual rule, low-risk). I'll apply a canary to 1% of traffic first and then 100% if looks good. Also raising a PR to trim header whitespace in selector eval.

support_lead: Please include repro steps so SRE/customer success can share with the customer and verify.

ajay.k: Repro steps I used:```
1) curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -H \"X-Tenant: acme-payments \" -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"input":"test"}' -v
2) Observe 429s or responses routed to coldpool in router logs.
3) Control-plane log lines show selector mismatch as above.
```

devon: Patch note: changing regex to `^\s*acme-.*:gold\s*$` or, better, trim header before eval. Will open a small patch to control-plane selector module to run `strings.TrimSpace(header)` prior to regex. Also checking history: a recent config merge added `strictSelectors=true` flag — that caused the strict behavior to be enforced cluster-wide. Reverting that flag for now on us-west-2.

eng-runtime-oncall: I applied the canary override. acme-payments traffic that previously hit coldpool is now pinned to gold-dedicated-usw2 for 1% -> ramping to 100% pending telemetry. Telemetry so far: error-rate down from 14% -> 1.2% in canary slice.

maria_p: For the customer-facing note: pls ask them to ensure their SDK doesn't append whitespace or commas when constructing headers. We'll also offer to roll a temporary header-normalization patch on their behalf.

support_lead: Documenting steps in the incident ticket. Thanks all. Can someone drop the PR/CL links?

devon: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/controlplane/changes/CL-4321 (trim header)

eng-runtime-oncall: Patch deployed to us-west-2 control-plane:rev 2.18.7-canary -> trimmed headers in selector eval. I left a rollback plan. Will monitor for 30m.

ajay.k: Confirming customer reports errors reduced and latency stable. Marking this as root cause = selector didn't normalize header (edge-case: trailing whitespace / concatenated header).

support_lead: Nice work. Followup actions: 1) backfill header normalization to other regions, 2) add unit tests for header edgecases, 3) notify SDK teams, 4) add internal doc about baking in header normalization in gateway.

maria_p: Adding the tweak to release notes and closing after 24h stability. :thumbsup:
